THE milestone's done-condition: every live leg carries a verdict per lever column (shipped / honest_negative / pending / blocked:<reason>). DO NOT ADD A NEW BUNDLED ROW.

legend.honest_negative: tested, failed the gate — hard levers/trail stand
legend.shipped_gate_failed: LIVE in config, but a LATER re-sweep failed its gate and the operator chose to HOLD (ref = memo/date). A cell here carries a STANDING decision to keep a lever whose justification has lapsed, so it must stay visible in the done-condition roll-up rather than be absorbed into either bucket.
